Since 1995

Owner-run, since 1995.

M&S Tree Service is owned and run by Miller Navarro. The company has been working on trees around Portland and Taft since 1995, under the same name and the same motto that's on the logo: honesty and integrity.

Plenty of customers know the company as Miller's Tree Service or Miller Tree Service, because Miller is the one who shows up, looks at the tree and shakes your hand. It's the same business. If you were searching for Miller's, you found him.

Ask Miller what makes M&S different and you won't get a sales pitch. You'll get this:

“A love for trees, and what thirty years of working on them has taught me.”Miller Navarro, owner

That's why the estimate is free and the price is fair, why the crew rakes up the small branches, and why so many reviews mention a second, third or sixth job. Customers who have used M&S for years are happy to tell you about it. Ask for references when you call.

  • Insured & bondedCovered on every job.
  • A+ rated and BBB accreditedAccredited with the Better Business Bureau.
  • Answered 24/7Storm damage doesn't keep business hours.
  • Credit cards acceptedPay the way that's easiest.
  • Homes and businessesResidential yards, rentals, apartment complexes and commercial lots.

The equipment

Already on the truck.

Bucket trucks, a spider lift, chippers and grinders. The crew shows up with what the job needs.
